page_title: Image 2 AI Image Generator, GPT Image 2 & Video Tools

sources.entry: Image 2 - AI image and video generator for creating, editing, and transforming visuals from prompts. #freemium

summary.name: Image 2
summary.one_liner: Image 2 is a web workspace for generating and editing AI images with the GPT Image 2 model, plus a separate AI video generator.
use_cases: Creating posters and marketing graphics with readable text
Generating e-commerce and packaging product shots
Mockuping app screens and UI concepts before coding
Producing multilingual campaign or landing page visuals
Turning still images into short videos
summary.what_it_does: The page describes a prompt-based workspace for creating still images with GPT Image 2 and videos with an AI Video Generator. Users write a prompt describing subject, scene, style and lighting, optionally add a reference image, then generate a few variations and compare them. Outputs can be saved to projects or refined in further iterations. The page highlights strength at rendering legible typography, photorealistic detail, and multilingual layouts. Example templates are listed, such as fan cam photos and city tour images.
notable: GPT Image 2 model with emphasis on accurate in-image text and typography
Reference image input to anchor generations
Separate AI Video Generator for motion from the same workspace
Saved projects and prompt examples to reuse
caveats: Credit-based usage is mentioned by the page, but its limits and costs are not stated
Platform support beyond the web app is not described
